candidates.change_summary: Remove the require check so any caller can withdraw the entire balance.
Change the transfer to only send 1 wei, so the recipient balance change after the call differs.
Replace the recipient with address(0), so funds are sent to the zero address instead of the provided _recipient.
Insert selfdestruct after the transfer, destroying the contract and preventing future withdrawAll calls.
Change the require condition to always revert, so the transfer never executes and the balance remains unchanged.
